[Lähde: BBC World | URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c70g35n4518o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss]
Mary Jo Campbell, the mother of the Kardashian-Jenner momager Kris Jenner, has died aged 91.

Jenner, 70, announced the news on Thursday on social media: "Today, we said goodbye to my beautiful Mommy MJ."

No cause of death was immediately provided. Campbell appeared on the family's reality programmes multiple times since they were first brought into the spotlight with Keeping Up with the Kardashians, which premiered in 2007.

"She taught us that family is everything. She showed us how to love unconditionally and how to find joy in the little moments. She showed me how to face life's challenges with resilience and faith," Jenner wrote.

---

[Lähde: NBC News | URL: https://www.nbcnews.com/pop-culture/pop-culture-news/kris-jenner-announces-death-mother-mary-jo-mj-shannon-rcna587888]
Mary Jo “MJ” Shannon, the mother of Kardashian “momager” Kris Jenner, has died, Jenner announced on July 16. She was 91 years old.

Jenner shared a heartfelt post about her mother, describing her as the “heart of our family.”

“Today, we said goodbye to my beautiful Mommy MJ,” Jenner said of Shannon in her social media post. “There are no words that could ever capture what she has meant to me or the heartbreak of having to say goodbye.”

In her social media post, Jenner reflected on the ways in which Shannon, known to fans of “The Kardashians” as “MJ,” had impacted her throughout the course her life. Shannon was the grandmother to the family’s famous stars including Kim Kardashian, Kourtney Kardashian, Kendall Jenner and Kylie Jenner.

“She taught me everything that truly matters… to love your family fiercely, to be kind, to show up for the people you love, and to never take a single moment together for granted,” Jenner wrote. “She taught us that family is everything. She showed us how to love unconditionally and how to find joy in the little moments. She showed me how to face life’s challenges with resilience and faith.”

Jenner, who said she was grateful for “every sacrifice” her mother made, also shared the aspects of Shannon that she will grieve.

“I will miss our daily talks, your smile, your laughter… Our hearts are broken, but we find comfort knowing that love like yours never truly leaves us,” Jenner wrote. “Your love will live on in our family, in our traditions, in every moment we are together, and in every life you touched.”

While Jenner said that the loss will be difficult for her and the family, she added that Shannon’s memory will live on.

“When I look at my kids and my grandkids, I will forever see pieces of you in all of us. There is not a part of me that isn’t shaped by you. And if I have done anything right in this world, it’s because I spent my life trying to live in a way that would make you proud,” Jenner wrote. “Every memory, every moment, every blessing, it was all because of you, and I will forever thank God every single day for making you my mommy.”

Jenner concluded her post by thanking Shannon for “giving us everything.”

“My heart is broken into a million pieces… thank you for giving me the greatest childhood and oh what a beautiful blessed life…” Jenner wrote. “I love you forever Mommy.”

---

Kris Jenner shared on Instagram that her mom, MJ, has died.

The matriarch of the Kardashian-Jenner family posted on Instagram announcing MJ's death on July 16, 2026. Mary Jo "MJ" Shannon was 91 years old and had two daughters, Kris and Karen Houghton, the latter of whom died in 2024.

payload.title: Kris Jennerin äiti Mary Jo ”MJ” kuoli 91-vuotiaana
payload.summary: Kris Jenner kertoi, että hänen 91-vuotias äitinsä Mary Jo ”MJ” on kuollut. Kardashian–Jenner-perheen televisiosarjoista tutun Mary Jon kuolinsyytä ei ole kerrottu.
payload.content:
Kardashian–Jenner-perheen televisio-ohjelmista tunnettu Mary Jo ”MJ”, Kris Jennerin äiti, on kuollut 91-vuotiaana. 70-vuotias Kris Jenner kertoi äitinsä kuolemasta torstaina 16. heinäkuuta sosiaalisessa mediassa. Kuolinsyytä ei ole toistaiseksi ilmoitettu. Jenner kuvaili äitiään perheensä sydämeksi. Mary Jo oli vuosien varrella esiintynyt useita kertoja perheen tositelevisio-ohjelmissa.

## Kris Jenner muisti äitiään lämpimin sanoin

Jenner kirjoitti perheen sanoneen samana päivänä hyvästit hänen ”kauniille äidilleen MJ:lle”. Hän sanoi, etteivät mitkään sanat pysty kuvaamaan sitä, mitä äiti hänelle merkitsi, tai sitä sydänsurua, jonka hyvästien jättäminen aiheutti. Julkaisu oli henkilökohtainen kiitos äidille, jonka vaikutus ulottui Jennerin mukaan koko perheeseen.

Jenner kertoi äitinsä opettaneen läheisilleen, että perhe on kaikki kaikessa. Hänen mukaansa Mary Jo näytti esimerkillään, kuinka rakastetaan ehdoitta, löydetään iloa pienistä hetkistä ja kohdataan elämän vaikeudet sitkeydellä ja uskolla. Jenner liitti nämä opetukset siihen, kuinka Mary Jo oli vaikuttanut häneen koko hänen elämänsä ajan.

”Sydämeni on särkynyt miljoonaksi palaseksi”, Jenner kirjoitti. Hän kiitti Mary Jota siitä, että tämä oli antanut hänelle parhaan mahdollisen lapsuuden, ja kuvasi äitinsä elämää kauniiksi ja siunatuksi. Viestinsä lopuksi hän kiitti äitiään kaikesta ja sanoi rakastavansa tätä ikuisesti.

## Mary Jo tuli tutuksi perheen televisiosarjoista

Mary Jo esiintyi vuosien mittaan useita kertoja Keeping Up with the Kardashians -sarjassa, joka alkoi vuonna 2007 ja toi perheen laajaan julkisuuteen. Hänet nähtiin myöhemmin myös Hulu-palvelun The Kardashians -sarjassa. Katsojat tunsivat hänet nimellä MJ, jota myös Kris Jenner käytti äidistään sosiaalisen median julkaisussa.

Mary Jo oli isoäiti muun muassa Kim Kardashianille, Kourtney Kardashianille, Kendall Jennerille ja Kylie Jennerille. Vaikka hän tuli suurelle yleisölle tutuksi televisiosta, Kris Jennerin muistokirjoitus käsitteli ennen kaikkea hänen asemaansa äitinä ja isoäitinä sekä perheelle välittämiään arvoja. Julkaisu ei sisältänyt tarkempia tietoja kuolemasta.
summary_bullets: Kris Jenner kuvaili äitiään perheen sydämeksi.
Mary Jo esiintyi useasti Kardashian–Jenner-perheen televisiosarjoissa.
payload.journalist_note: Tausta-aineistossa Mary Jon sukunimi esiintyy sekä muodossa Shannon että Campbell. Ristiriidan vuoksi julkisessa tekstissä käytetään vain varmistettuja nimiä Mary Jo ja MJ.

article.journalist_note: Tausta-aineistossa Mary Jon sukunimi esiintyy sekä muodossa Shannon että Campbell. Ristiriidan vuoksi julkisessa tekstissä käytetään vain varmistettuja nimiä Mary Jo ja MJ.
article.source_text:
Mary Jo Campbell, the mother of the Kardashian-Jenner momager Kris Jenner, has died aged 91. Jenner, 70, announced the news on Thursday on social media: "Today, we said goodbye to my beautiful Mommy MJ." No cause of death was immediately provided. Campbell appeared on the family's reality programmes multiple times since they were first brought into the spotlight with Keeping Up with the Kardashians, which premiered in 2007. "She taught us that family is everything. She showed us how to love unconditionally and how to find joy in the little moments. She showed me how to face life's challenges with resilience and faith," Jenner wrote. ---

Mary Jo Campbell was featured on multiple episodes of Keeping Up with the Kardashians over the years.

Mary Jo “MJ” Shannon, the mother of Kardashian “momager” Kris Jenner, has died, Jenner announced on July 16. She was 91 years old. Jenner shared a heartfelt post about her mother, describing her as the “heart of our family.” “Today, we said goodbye to my beautiful Mommy MJ,” Jenner said of Shannon in her social media post. “There are no words that could ever capture what she has meant to me or the heartbreak of having to say goodbye.” In her social media post, Jenner reflected on the ways in which Shannon, known to fans of “The Kardashians” as “MJ,” had impacted her throughout the course her life. Shannon was the grandmother to the family’s famous stars including Kim Kardashian, Kourtney Kardashian, Kendall Jenner and Kylie Jenner.

"My heart is broken into a million pieces… thank you for giving me the greatest childhood and oh what a beautiful blessed life." Her post ended, "I love you forever Mommy. Thank you for giving us everything." MJ appeared multiple times on Keeping Up with the Kardashians and Hulu's The Kardashians.
